description: Compare 2+ image creatives (thumbnails, display banners, social images) against a synthetic audience. Creates the experiment, uploads the images, attaches the audience and drafts the comparison (free). It then returns status 'needs_price_confirmation' with the quoted simulation sessions; nothing is spent until you re-call with accept_sessions >= the quote (pass accept_sessions up front to skip the pause). To confirm a draft already created, pass comparison_id + accept_sessions only. Cost scales with creatives x personas; an audience group is capped at 10 personas per segment. choice_task adds a forced-choice round (choiceCost in the quote). Collect the ranking with aetherya_get_result kind 'creative_comparison'. Results are simulated, not real-user data.

accept_sessions.description: Sessions you accept to spend; must cover the quote.

choice_task.description: Also run a forced-choice task (each persona picks one creative). Adds sessions; the quote shows choiceCost.

comparison_id.description: Confirm and run a draft created by an earlier call.

creatives.description: 2-10 creatives to compare. Needed unless you pass comparison_id.

body.description: Body copy shown with the image.

concept.description: Creatives sharing a concept are grouped; the first is its representative.

persona_ids.description: Persona ids (see aetherya_list_audiences), instead of an audience group.

name: aetherya_compare_creatives
title: Compare image creatives
